title: Validate the dossier and export the eCTD package
walkthrough:
You start on the dossier manager page, headed "Your product dossiers", under a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" with links to "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →". Each dossier is a card tile showing its ID, product name, a progress bar, and a status chip reading either "Ready to file" or a count like "3/4 modules". Clicking a tile opens the dossier's Module 1 workspace.

The workspace has three zones: a section tree on the left, the selected section's panel in the middle, and a right-hand rail of cards. The top bar shows tabs "M1" through "M5" (each marked with a check, dot, or dash), plus chips for "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio" and "Journey". A rail card summarizes the module ("required sections complete" count, e.g. "12/15") and shows three readiness flags: "Documents", "Fee", and "Valid eCTD", each ticked or open-circled. If anything is outstanding it says, for example, "3 item(s) still needed to file (documents, fee, or validation)."

Validation lives in the rail card labeled "eCTD validation". Its status badge reads "● PASSED" or an error count such as "● 4 error(s)". Each finding is a one-line row prefixed with a rule code (styled like Health Canada IDs, "CA-E-…/CA-W-…"); the first five errors and three warnings show by default, with "Show all 12 errors" / "Show fewer" toggles. This card initially reflects structural checks only; you click "Run full check (PDF conformance)" (button shows "Checking…" while it runs) to validate the stored PDF bytes as well. There is no separate results screen — findings appear inline in the same small card.

Exporting is done from the adjacent "Sequences" card, which lists each eCTD sequence (e.g. "0000") with a purpose chip ("Initial", "Response", "Supplement", "Annual notification"), a leaf count, and either an "● ACTIVE" badge or a "Make active" button. Each row has an "Export" chip; its tooltip reads "Download the eCTD package for sequence 0000", and clicking it downloads the package directly — there is no confirmation step, and export is not blocked by validation status. To add a sequence you click "New sequence", pick a purpose, optionally type a note (placeholder: "Note (e.g. screening deficiency SDN-1)"), and click "Create & make active".

One non-obvious point: dossiers created with a placeholder ID show a "draft ID — set real ✎" chip; a browser prompt asks you to "Enter the Dossier ID issued by Health Canada (one letter + 6–7 digits, e.g. e123456)" before filing, and validation reminds you of this.
